_comment: The letter spacing a fit-to-width block writes on its heading (#458). save.js writes it as letter-spacing in em, buildEditorStyle() in blocks/typography-stylist/editor-style.js writes the same value as --typost-fit-letter-spacing in the editor, and Typost::add_fit_letter_spacing_property() in typography-stylist.php copies it from the saved declaration into --typost-fit-letter-spacing at render time. Read by blocks/typography-stylist/__tests__/css-js-mirrors.test.js (letterSpacing -> value) and tests/Unit/FitLetterSpacingTest.php (value -> property), so a value the block writes that the filter cannot read fails one of them. A case with styleClass and overrideKeys is a block on top of a paragraph style that overrides the letter spacing (#451): 0 writes letter-spacing: normal, which the property must also get, or the lines take the style's value from its class rule.

cases.label: none on top of a style
an override on top of a style
